newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian lira firms to below 1,000 per mark-dealers.
newsitem.headline: Italian lira firms to below 1,000 per mark-dealers.

text.p: The Italian lira, testing the 1,000 per mark level in the early afternoon, briefly firmed to touch a screen-quoted high of 999.80 despite a weaker dollar.
One trader said "we have been seeing stop-loss orders." Another said there had been "a large order of French francs sold for lire."
A third commented, "if the lira goes below 1,000, which is a technical rather than psychologocal resistance, the trading range will be 992-998 per mark."
At 1332 GMT, the lira was quoted at 1,000.30/0.80 per mark.
The lira touched a 26-month high against the mark at 988.40 on October 7.
